@ a delay at sample / 4 gives its value at the ticks 0, 4, 8, 12 and keeps it between, across the calls and their blocks
@ a call that ends between two ticks keeps the phase: the next tick is where the frame count says
@ render is one call: the value of p is the same at every tick
render slow_tick_node_values.hold sr=0x41000000 params p=0x40a00000 frames=9
@ the first output of a delay at a tick is its init, and a reset gives it again
@ two ticks of different ratios: sample / 2 gives its first stored value at frame 2, sample / 4 at frame 4
render slow_tick_node_values.two_rates sr=0x41000000 params p=0x40400000 frames=8
@ a loop at sample / 4 counts once per tick
render slow_tick_node_values.count_ticks sr=0x41000000 params p=0x3f800000 frames=12
@ a part computed at the tick is computed at the tick: the p it reads is the one of the call of the tick
@ a delay of a struct at a tick starts with the Default of the struct
render slow_tick_node_values.default_of_a_struct sr=0x41000000 params p=0x40400000 frames=8
@ sample_rate() is the rate of the sample of the body in a stage of sample / 4 too
